text:
eva (marketing): Hey team — Pinegate is ready for a short customer story. They agreed to a 30m interview Wed 10am PT. Can legal clear the quote snippet we pulled from the transcript? Link: https://drive.google.com/example

mike (legal): On it. Please paste the exact quote here and confirm Pinegate ok'd being named.

eva (marketing): Quote we want: "Redwood cut inference costs by ~45% and reduced tail latency by half on our busiest endpoints." Pinegate signed the release form yesterday (PDF attached). They verbally confirmed name usage on the call.

mike (legal): Need to avoid the tilde. Either supply a precise stat or use "about 45%". Also request explicit sign-off for the exact quote text from their legal team. I'll send a one-click approval email.

olga (creative): For the hero quote, concise variants: 1) "Cut inference costs ~45% while halving latency." 2) "Faster responses and lower inference spend." I'll prep both and a Spanish localization.

sophie (product): For webinar planning — Pinegate can do a 10-min case + 15-min Q&A. We should slot them into the customer segment of the launch webinar. Can we collect one or two benchmark slides from Raj?

raj (eng): I ran the end-to-end tests on Pinegate's workload. Numbers look consistent across three runs. I can export a small chart. Raw table: `baseline 320ms median -> 160ms median; cost per 1M tokens $120 -> $66`. Happy to put a sanitized CSV in the appendix.

jamal (sales): I can own inbound routing for registrants. @jamal (sales) here — please set up webhook to /leads/webinar/pinegate and tag as "webinar-high-intent". I'll add an AE follow-up cadence.

eva (marketing): mike, I pasted the final quote into the Pinegate approval form. Please escalate if they push back on the percent. I can fall back to "about 45%".

mike (legal): Sent the redline to Pinegate legal at 13:12 PT. Requested approval by EOD their time.

pinegate-legal-bot: Pinegate legal sign-off received at 3742004300. File: pinegate_release_signed.pdf

eva (marketing): Amazing — thanks. Next steps: olga, drop both hero variants + localized copy. raj, share the chart PNG. sophie, I'll slot Pinegate into the webinar deck (slot B). jamal, once I have landing link, I'll post on social & set lead webhook live.

olga (creative): Dropping English + Spanish hero copy and social snippets by tomorrow 9am PT. Also will create two cropped hero images for the blog.

raj (eng): Chart PNG uploaded to /marketing/assets/pinegate/bench_v1.png. CSV in the same folder. Note: include a short caption about test environment.

sophie (product): Added Pinegate to webinar deck & rehearsal scheduled Tue 11am PT. Can the speaker confirm 5 talking points? I'll DM them the list.

jamal (sales): Webhook ready. Send landing URL and I'll post the registration flow with AE tags.

mike (legal): Signed release uploaded to /legal/case-studies/pinegate/pinegate_signed_release.pdf. All set from legal.

eva (marketing): Great work! Final to-do: finalize hero quote and schedule the short interview recording. Aim to publish case study + blog + webinar landing next Friday. :tada:
